decisions.reason: Positive but still vague early results keep the option's market value uncertain, and its dedicated page signals low carrying cost relative to the option value.
With no negative results and a dedicated page, the option's uncertainty remains unresolved and the firm can continue carrying it at modest cost.
Only a brief website mention suggests the option has not shown enough value, and with many other options the firm is likely to shift resources away from it.
The lack of a dedicated page and any reported result indicates the option's value is unlikely to be realized, so releasing resources is warranted.
Similar to the general high-speed grinder, this green-waste variant has only a mention, and the firm's many options make it less likely to keep this one.
The dedicated page shows ongoing commitment, and with no negative results the option remains open under uncertainty at acceptable cost.
